label: Screencast / Browser Frame
description:
THE component for presenting real screen recordings (or screenshots) -- never hand-roll a browser mock around a <video>. Renders the footage in a polished device frame: frame_style 'macos-browser' draws a mac window bar (traffic lights + address pill), 'plain' is a clean rounded card, 'none' is edge-to-edge. crop:'auto' reads the footage's ingest analysis and crops any window chrome the RECORDING ITSELF contains (a screencast of a full browser window carries its own address bar -- framing it without cropping shows two stacked headers).

SPEAKER-SCREENCAST RECIPE (product walkthrough / demo where the presenter's camera rides along as a corner bubble): set the SCENE to transparent_background:false (opaque), wire a project speaker_track to the camera clip, and configure THIS component as { frame_style:'none', max_width_pct:88 (inset ~20px top/bottom so it floats, not edge-to-edge), corner_radius:28-32, pip_source:'speaker', pip_shape:'circle', pip_size:15, pip_position:'bottom-right' }. corner_radius is REQUIRED here even in 'none' mode: screen recordings captured from a ROUNDED-corner window carry opaque BLACK in the source's own corners (outside the window's radius); the rounded frame clip masks that black with the scene background. A flat/edge-to-edge full-bleed recording from a rounded window WILL show black corner wedges -- round it. Give the scene a background (brand gradient or color) since the inset reveals it around the card.

frame_style.label: Frame style: none (edge-to-edge / full-bleed; honors corner_radius + max_width_pct for an inset floating card -- use for speaker screencasts) | plain | macos-browser | phone (device bezel + island for vertical app footage; composes with presentation:'float' and callouts)

crop.label: Source crop: 'auto' (recommended -- uses ingest analysis) or {top,bottom,left,right} in SOURCE pixels

corner_radius.label: Frame corner radius px. Honored in ALL frame_styles including 'none'. For a full-bleed ('none') recording from a rounded-corner window, set 28-32 to mask the black corner wedges baked into the source.

shape.label: Set 'circle' (frame_style 'none' only) for a square, center-cover-cropped circular clip -- the camera-bubble look. Overrides corner_radius.

max_width_pct.label: Frame width as % of the component box. Honored in 'none' mode too: set ~88 to inset a full-bleed screencast ~20px top/bottom so it floats as a card over the scene background (aspect ratio pulls the sides in proportionally).

presentation.label: Presentation: default | float (tilted 3D plane with orbit drift + floor reflection, for DARK worlds -- the launch-film look; hides the chrome bar)

callouts.label: Array of {at, dur?, x, y, w, h, travel?}: at in scene seconds, region in % of the displayed content -- a zoomed duplicate of that region lifts out in a brand-gradient glow shell while the base dims (the '3D callout'). travel (0.35-2s, default 0.9) is the flight duration out/back -- the reverse-zoom speed.

island.label: Phone only: show the floating island pill (default true)

pip_source.label: Camera PiP: a video URL (/assets/... a talking-head/camera clip) shown as a small bubble pinned to a corner over the screencast. Muted -- put the camera's audio on a project audio track (or use it as the speaker track). Pass the literal 'speaker' in speaker-track mode to auto-bind the camera + sync.

pip_position.label: PiP corner: bottom-right (default) | bottom-left | top-right | top-left

pip_size.label: PiP width as % of the frame (default 22, clamped 8-42). A talking-head bubble reads best around 14-16 -- 22+ dominates the frame ('a quarter of the screen').

pip_shape.label: PiP shape: rounded (default, 16:9 rounded rect) | circle

pip_start_at.label: Seconds into the camera clip where this scene's PiP starts (default 0; speaker-track mode sets it automatically)
